scope: Additive native/Swift public HTTPS factory with owned foreign-executor support; no app/durable-cache acceptance

behavior.constructor: Additive named UniFFI FeedSourceSessionV1::public_https and Swift BookNookFeedSourcesV1.publicHTTPS(configuration:). Existing callback constructor preserved.
behavior.inactive_offline: Construction validates configuration/descriptor only; no runtime initialization, DNS or HTTP. Local activation remains explicit.
behavior.foreign_executor: One lazy shared native Tokio runtime, two worker threads and four blocking threads, enable_all. No caller reactor, per-call runtime or block_on required.
behavior.cancellation: Private PublicFeedTask owns spawned JoinHandle and cancellation token; premature future drop cancels token and aborts work. Successful completion disarms cleanup so the read stays usable.
behavior.storage_boundary: Existing opaque attempt/read and guarded synchronous final cache CAS unchanged. No durable storage is added or qualified.
behavior.transport: Same isolated PublicHttpsFeedProvider production constructor. Its separate verification receipt records resolver pinning, peer verification, deadlines, isolation, redirect and byte/header/encoding limits.
behavior.output: Untrusted bounded raw feed bytes; the opt-in smoke explicitly activates before fetching, then normalizes exact returned bytes into inert records. Normalization itself performs no source activation, media fetch, persistence or rendering.
